name: Minnesota Consumer Data Privacy Act
description: Minnesota's comprehensive consumer privacy law. HF 4757 (2024), signed May 24 2024, effective July 31 2025.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by State of Minnesota (mn.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within State of Minnesota (mn.gov).
